g.text: Actual annual expenses, 2001-2025; matching Treasury fiscal-year GDP denominators
Benefit spending relative to the economy
Derived expense history / approximate grouping | Actuals from five Treasury vintages; accounting, classification and programme
coverage change. The main basket is approximate across the 2013 reform. Recent GDP comes from BEFU 2026; earlier GDP from the
fiscal-history workbook. A COVID spike includes employer wage subsidies.
Sources: 7 official releases; full URLs and vintages in chart catalogue and gallery
